Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing — follow-up & next steps

Hi Olivia (and Derek),

Thanks again for the call earlier — really helpful walkthrough of your production requirements. Quick recap and a few sizing questions so our engineering team can build an accurate Dedicated capacity proposal and SOW: 

Call recap (high level):
- Goal: Serve Finovate AI’s assistant + knowledge retrieval features with predictable latency and cost.
- Primary constraint: low 95th-percentile latency for short prompts (under 200ms target for 99% of requests if possible).
- Data residency: US-only for initial rollout; potential Private VPC option later.

Sizing questions (can you confirm numbers below?):
1) Deployment mode preference: Hosted API vs Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) vs Private (VPC or on-prem). On the call you said Dedicated looks most likely — can you confirm?
2) Preferred GPU family (if known): A100 80GB, A100 40GB, H100, or other?
3) Target throughput (TPS) and expected peak TPS window (e.g., 8 TPS sustained, 20 TPS burst over 5–10 minutes).
4) Target concurrency (number of simultaneous in-flight requests across users).
5) Token mix and average context length: percent short (<64 tokens), medium (64–512), long (>512). Examples of typical prompts/responses help.
6) Models you want to run (if decided) and whether you need multi-model routing (e.g., smaller model for short completions, larger for long-form).
7) Timeline for PoC and production (best estimate).

Attached is our sizing template (redwood-dedicated-sizing-template.xlsx) — if you can fill the TPS/concurrency/token columns that would be perfect.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm answers above by EOD tomorrow if possible.
- We do a short 30-min sizing call with our infra lead (Marissa) to validate assumptions.
- I’ll send a draft SOW and pricing based on your answers.

Thanks — Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes

Redwood Inference

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@finovateai.com>

Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing — follow-up & next steps

Hi Rafael — thanks for the clear recap. Answers below based on what we discussed and the internal sizing exercise we ran after the call.

1) Deployment mode: Dedicated capacity with reserved GPUs in a US region. We are open to Private VPC if it doesn’t add >2 weeks to rollout; for now we want Dedicated.
2) Preferred GPU: A100 80GB is our preference (we have internal precedent and budgeted for it).
3) TPS targets: baseline 6 TPS sustained; expected peak up to 10 TPS sustained for high-traffic periods; burst up to 25 TPS for short periods (~5–10 min).
4) Concurrency: target ~25 concurrent requests across our service (spikes to ~40 during large batch jobs).
5) Token mix (approx): 85% short (<64 tokens), 10% medium (64–512 tokens), 5% long (>512 tokens). Average response size ~40–120 tokens.
6) Models: we'll start with a single production model (RWD-qa-v1, ~8B-ish equivalent) and keep a larger model on standby for long-form support. We’d like automatic fallback to the larger model when prompt length >512 tokens.
7) Timeline: PoC in 3–4 weeks; production rollout within 8–10 weeks if pricing and SOW align.

Also copying procurement for contract/PO steps. Please provide a draft SOW and a ballpark monthly pricing for the Dedicated reservation based on A100 80GB.

Thanks,
Olivia

--
